lines.text: You made the street loud. Don't stand near me.
Wrong kind of loud. Put it away.
Terminal's behind the counter. Trace down here is Sable's, so jack light.
Truce holds. Doesn't mean we talk.
Ghost template. You'll want the House Lights core one night. Everybody does once.
Spare Parts. Everything in here used to be something else. Us too.

barks.text: Thirty seconds of dark. You'd be amazed what thirty seconds is worth on this street.
Halo's the next door along. End of the street. You can't miss it. People do.
Old Works is loud tonight. That's not a complaint.
Everything's salvage eventually. Some of us just got there early.
Don't buy a program off anyone who's smiling.
